dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: The Invoice Tax Administrator role is available once SAP Concur staff enable the feature.

dependencyCandidates.condition: The corpus enumerates five inputs the system needs before VAT can be calculated: Tax Authority, Expense type, Date, Location, Vendor. This 5-item list is the dependency spine for everything configured on this page.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: VAT applies to some—but not all—expense types

dependencyCandidates.condition: Effective Date is required and End Date is optional on both group wizards; leaving End Date blank makes the system use the documented default 12/31/9999, so an expiring group and its successor are chained by date rather than deleted.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: If no end date is specified, the system uses the date of 12/31/9999

dependencyCandidates.condition: The Specify Tax in Invoice Details or Itemization Summary feature is activated through an 11-step Forms and Fields procedure that adds VAT fields to BOTH the Payment Request Header and the Payment Request Line Item Details form types. An optional read-only Line Item VAT Amount roll-up field may be added to the header form.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: The admin must add at least one VAT field at the header and at the line item level for the Specify Tax in Invoice Details or Itemization Summary feature to show on the Payment Request Header form of the invoice.

dependencyCandidates.condition: PROVISIONING GATE. The Invoice Tax Administrator role does not appear in User Permissions at all until SAP Concur staff enable the Tax Validation feature, so which tabs a tenant sees on this page is provisioning-dependent and cannot be inferred from the docs alone.
dependencyCandidates.sourceQuote: The Concur Administrator completes the steps outlined below to expose the Invoice Tax Administrator role in User Permissions

contradictions.topic: Country support for VAT: admin-guides declares US, Canada and India unsupported while tools-guides gives both of them full VAT field implementations
contradictions.readingA: supported-countries-for-vat-8b38bab8.md: 'Countries that are not supported for VAT in Concur Invoice are the US, Canada, India, and other multi-tax countries.' Primary supported = United Kingdom, Japan, Australia.
contradictions.readingB: canada-de22c9f9.md gives a four-field and a two-field Canadian VAT labelling scheme (GST/PST/HST/QST), and uk-us-japan-australia-0557084a.md says 'For the UK, the US, Japan, and Australia, use the VAT Amount 1 field, which is for primary tax.' Both are tools-guides-only. Not reconciled: most likely 'supported' means different things in the two guides (Tax Authority auto-calculation vs Capture Processing field capture), but the corpus never says so.

contradictions.topic: The two raw-<table> OCR/Capture field tables disagree about Canadian tax capture
contradictions.readingA: tools-guides what-fields-are-extracted-during-the-ocr-process-8eddb3cf.md lists 'Vat 1 (Primary Tax - Canada GST/HST, Australia GST, US Tax, VAT UK/Japan) **' AND a separate cell 'Vat 2 (Secondary Tax – Canada PST/QST) *'.
contradictions.readingB: admin-guides configuring-forms-and-fields-in-capture-processing-7c14446c.md lists 'Vat 1 (Australia GST, US Tax, VAT UK/Japan) *' - Canada GST/HST removed from the Vat 1 description and NO Vat 2 row at all. Both files are raw <table> HTML. These tables belong to page.capture-processing-admin (already built) and are cited here only for the tax contradiction; no field is re-homed.

contradictions.topic: Tax Validation tab control labels differ between the configuration topic and the options topic
contradictions.readingA: step-3-configure-the-service-14c3ef13.md field table: 'Partner Account Number', 'Tax Validation Type', 'Tax Validation Level' (values Header / Line Item).
contradictions.readingB: work-with-the-tax-validation-page-options-c3fe1df5.md prose: 'Unique Tax Partner Number', 'Request Type to be Analyzed', 'Form Level to Be Analyzed' (values header / line item details form). Different loio, same deliverable_id. Both label sets emitted as separate field records; a crawler must expect either.

contradictions.topic: Two different navigation paths for assigning the Invoice Tax Administrator role
contradictions.readingA: step-2-assign-the-tax-administrator-role-b7f391c8.md: 'Click User Administration > User Permissions > Invoice tab of the Company Admin tool.'
contradictions.readingB: step-2-assign-the-tax-administrator-role-b903b7c8.md: 'Click Administration > Company > Company Admin.' then 'Click User Permissions (left menu) and then click the Invoice tab.' Same title, different loio. Not reconciled.

contradictions.topic: Predefined tax codes: which downstream fields become lists
contradictions.readingA: configure-predefined-tax-codes-6b42509f.md: 'The user will now see the tax code fields (1-4) as a list in the Invoice Details and Itemization Summary sections of the invoice.' - four fields.
contradictions.readingB: step-7-optional-configure-predefined-tax-codes-be8bc5b8.md: 'The user will now see the VAT Tax Code 1 field as a list in the Invoice Details and Itemization Summary sections of the invoice.' - one field. Different loio, same deliverable_id 41460672; the Select/Click difference elsewhere in these two topics IS the gerund/imperative republication pattern, but this sentence is a genuine substantive divergence, so it is recorded, not reconciled. A third topic states Tax Authority currently supports only one VAT amount field (VAT Amount 1/VAT Rate 1/VAT Tax Code 1), which leans toward reading B but does not settle it.

contradictions.topic: Navigation alias drift for the Tax Administration page itself
contradictions.readingA: 'Administration > Invoice > Tax Administration (left menu)' (configure-predefined-tax-codes-6b42509f.md, step-7) and 'Click Administration > Invoice.' then 'Click Tax Administration left menu.' (step-3-access-tax-authorities-2fae4ae3.md).
contradictions.readingB: 'click Administration > Invoice Admin > Tax Administration' (step-3-configure-the-service-14c3ef13.md), and the-basic-process-13c136d5.md speaks of 'exposing the Tax Administration link in Invoice Admin'. 'Invoice Admin' is a live alias for 'Administration > Invoice'. Note also the menu entry is called the 'Tax Administration link' in one topic and the 'Tax Administrator link' in another.

contradictions.topic: Tab label for the expense type group tab
contradictions.readingA: the-basic-process-12a5686d.md: 'Administration > Invoice > Tax Administration > Expense Type Groups tab' (plural Groups).
contradictions.readingB: step-5-optional-add-a-new-expense-type-group-to-a-tax-authority-e8d87361.md: 'On the Expense Types Group tab, select from the Tax Authority list.' (plural Types, singular Group). Both retained.

contradictions.topic: Applies To value casing differs between the expense type group and vendor group wizards
contradictions.readingA: step-5 (expense type groups): 'Select the Payment Request document type' - capital R.
contradictions.readingB: step-6 (vendor groups): 'Select the Payment request document type' - lowercase r. Both reproduced verbatim rather than normalised. step-6 additionally says its Applies To setting 'appears as a column on the Expense Type Groups page', naming the wrong page for a vendor group - recorded as-is.

contradictions.topic: Role name for the gate on this page
contradictions.readingB: 'Tax Administrator' - required-roles-81c8eace.md: 'To add and manage tax authorities, the user needs to have the Tax Administrator role.' the-basic-process-12a5686d.md also uses the bare 'Tax Administrator role'. Both retained.

contradictions.topic: Default tax condition wording on the two group wizards' Tax Rates step
contradictions.readingA: step-5: 'the default tax condition of Always which means that this tax rate will always apply.'
contradictions.readingB: step-6: 'the default tax condition of Always – meaning this tax rate will always apply.' (EN-DASH U+2013). Same semantics, different punctuation; recorded because the exact source characters matter for grounding.

compressedRanges.label: Vat Amount 1 - 4
compressedRanges.expandsTo: VAT Amount 1, VAT Amount 2, VAT Amount 3, VAT Amount 4 - the four header-level VAT amount fields supported for capture. Source characters: space-hyphen-space, NOT an en-dash, and 'Vat' not 'VAT'.

compressedRanges.label: Vat Amount 2 - 4
compressedRanges.expandsTo: VAT Amount 2, VAT Amount 3, VAT Amount 4 - the line-item-level range, which starts at 2 because 'Vat 1 (Primary Tax ...)' is listed as its own cell. Source characters: space-hyphen-space.

compressedRanges.label: Vat Amount 1 - 4
compressedRanges.expandsTo: VAT Amount 1, VAT Amount 2, VAT Amount 3, VAT Amount 4 - admin-guides twin of the tools OCR table; same range characters but the surrounding row set differs (no Vat 2 row).

compressedRanges.label: the tax code fields (1-4)
compressedRanges.expandsTo: VAT Tax Code 1, VAT Tax Code 2, VAT Tax Code 3, VAT Tax Code 4 - what the corpus says becomes a list once predefined tax codes exist. Source characters: parenthesised '1-4' with a plain hyphen, no spaces. CONTRADICTED by step-7, which names only VAT Tax Code 1.

compressedRanges.label: the VAT amount fields 1-4
compressedRanges.expandsTo: Line Item VAT Amount 1, Line Item VAT Amount 2, Line Item VAT Amount 3, Line Item VAT Amount 4 - the content the VAT Type label displays, at line item level. Source characters: plain hyphen, no spaces.

notes: LENS B, Tax Administration. MECHANICAL SWEEP RUN FIRST, as required: grep -c '<table' plus grep -c '^ *|' over (a) every file whose NAME matches tax|vat in both guide directories and (b) every file whose CONTENT matches 'Tax Administration|Tax Authorit' in both guide directories. Result: ZERO raw <table> elements in any Tax Administration-owned file. Every field record here therefore carries fromRawHtmlTable:false, correctly. The only two raw <table> files in the tax neighbourhood (what-fields-are-extracted-during-the-ocr-process-8eddb3cf.md and configuring-forms-and-fields-in-capture-processing-7c14446c.md) are owned by page.capture-processing-admin, which is already built; I read both in full and cite them ONLY for contradiction #2 and for compressed ranges. | TABLES ENUMERATED IN FULL, NO SAMPLING: Tax Authorities grid columns (4/4), New Tax Authority General step (4/4), Tax Rate Types step (2/2), Tax Rates step (3/3), Expense Type Group Name step (6/6), Vendor Group Name step (6/6), Tax Validation tab (6/6), Available VAT Fields (27/27), Prorated VAT Fields (12/12), VAT labels (4/4), digital tax invoice statuses (4/4), Canada four-field (4/4) and two-field (2/2) labelling. | ILLUSTRATIVE MATERIAL DELIBERATELY SKIPPED, and why: appendix-a-tax-amount-calculation-8b380a96.md and uk-example-applicable-to-all-single-level-vat-countries-ef37bb45.md are worked arithmetic examples (Net = 147.25/1.175 etc.) - a calculation demonstration, not a settings table, so no fields were extracted from them. tax-authority-8b386a59.md (64 pipe-table lines), tax-validation-8b37962d.md (49), image-handling-digital-tax-invoice-8b2fb78f.md (46) and value-added-tax-vat-8b39be89.md (13) were opened because the sweep flagged them; all four are REVISION HISTORY tables (Date | Notes/Comments/Changes) with zero configuration content, so they are cited nowhere. The Switch Tax Mode 'Example 1 / Example 2' figures are screenshot captions. | WHAT I COULD NOT DETERMINE: (1) whether Calculation Method has any value other than Percentage - it is called 'the default choice' but no alternative is ever named, and I refused to invent one; (2) whether any tax condition other than 'Always' can be chosen on either group wizard's Tax Rates step; (3) the option lists behind Country, State/Province, Rate Type, Expense Types and Vendors - all tenant-populated or SAP-imported, so their absence is correct, not a gap; (4) the UNSPSC code catalog, which is imported by SAP Concur and never enumerated here; (5) the cleared state and default of the three checkboxes (Disable VAT calculation x2, Turn On Tax Validation) - only the selected state is documented, and completing a No/Yes pair is exactly the defect this project already paid for; (6) the full Tax Type list on the Vendor Name step, which the source itself truncates with 'etc.'; (7) whether Tax Validation is a tab or a page - it is CLICKED as a tab ('Click the Tax Validation tab.') but then called 'the Tax Validation page' throughout. | WITHHOLDING TAX: grep for 'withholding' returns ZERO files across both guide directories. Withholding tax is not documented in this corpus at all; no control was invented for it. | SECONDARY VAT COUNTRIES: described only as a class ('countries that have one tax type that levy tax') and never listed. There is no secondary-country list to recover - other-countries-84722445.md defers to the Account Manager and to the Concur Invoice: VAT Setup Guide, which is NOT in this corpus. That is an honest boundary, not a thin extraction. | PAGE OWNERSHIP: five value sets carry an EMPTY appliesToField on purpose - Available VAT Fields, Prorated VAT Fields, VAT labels, and the two Canada labelling schemes describe fields owned by page.forms-and-fields (already built), and the digital tax invoice statuses are a runtime processor display. Wiring them to a Tax Administration field would be the mis-home failure mode; they are carried complete, with dependency edges instead. | BEYOND THE INVENTORY: my own sweep surfaced files the inventory did not list, and I read them - the-basic-process-13c136d5.md (the Tax Validation basic process, which supplied the Turn On Tax Validation activation gate and the 'Tax Administration link in Invoice Admin' alias), required-roles-81c8eace.md (the bare 'Tax Administrator' role contradiction), step-1-add-vat-fields-to-forms-6d93bfcd.md, the six vat-at-/vat-fields-at- level topics, australia-and-new-zealand-0bdf2180.md (invoice RETENTION guidance, not tax config - no fields taken), and vendor-information-for-vat-included-in-the-unit-price. None of them contained an unclaimed settings table.
